items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: He and Clifford Solomon lived in California, Los Angeles.

ctx.x: But your name was associated with it by now.

It was associated with it, right. I went to a jam session on...It was Christmas, during the holiday, New Year's. Anthony Ortega, he was also in the band. I forgot about him. We called him "Batman." Batman was in the band, and he lived in Los Angeles. And when I got there, well naturally, he was kind of showing...He and Clifford Solomon lived in California, Los Angeles.

And we had talked about forming a group out of Hamp's band, within the band, after we left. And there was a jam session going on, and Batman said, 'I want you to come over to...' what was it, I forgot the little town they was having the jam session at. 'And there's a New Year's Eve party, and we can play, man, we can play.' And I'm anxious to do that because I need to meet the local musicians, find out what's happening, try to get in on it, in the clique or whatever.
